sheets.title: Settings › Security, where Duress profiles would sit — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Guest vault, Settings › Security scrolled to Vault key protection. The Duress profiles panel (and its Trigger codes row, the one this change edits) renders between Vault key protection and Unlock methods only when resolveDuressMode returns local_only or optional_peer. The shipped build calls it with an empty object, so both builds draw the same screen: the branch's 'Slot 1: enrolled' without a digest prefix is not reachable here, and neither was the base's 'digest xxxxxxxx…'.
